field_evidence.connect_note: From June 2024 monthly crime datasets are extracted and compiled from the MPS CONNECT system.
field_evidence.tno_note: TNO data follows Home Office counting rules; Other Accepted Crime is non-notifiable and must be excluded when calculating TNO totals.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the Metropolitan Police Service Monthly Crime Dashboard Data. Published data contains two geography types, Borough and Safer Neighbourhood Team (SNT), identified by the Area Type column. The current M1045_MonthlyCrimeDashboard_TNOCrimeData.csv resource covers September 2022 through August 2026, and measures include Offences, Positive Outcomes and Positive Outcome Rate. This batch binds the verified Campden SNT area to that unused official TNO source window without claiming an extracted Campden row, parcel join or programme progress.
